retrievalProfile.description: A technical, minimalist layout featuring a large central numeral overlaid on a film leader countdown graphic with industrial stencil-style headers.
triggerTerms: technical drawing background with large numeral
stencil text with drop shadow on gray
excludeWhen: organic or hand-drawn textures are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, industrial composition centered on a large sans-serif numeral. The background consists of a light gray field with thin, technical crosshairs and concentric white circles reminiscent of a motion picture film leader. A secondary line of text at the top uses a heavy, rounded stencil font with a distinct offset shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central numeral as the primary focal point
Concentric circles framing the central subject
Technical crosshairs providing a geometric grid
Top-aligned stencil text contrasting with the central figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A massive numeral occupies the central 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central numeral, grounded by the vertical and horizontal crosshairs.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top red text, drop to the large central figure, and then follow the concentric circles outward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample light gray space around the central figure, broken only by thin technical lines.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Light gray background with a subtle paper-like grain.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal or black for the central numeral and technical lines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the top-level display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation background with high contrast dark elements and a single high-saturation accent.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric sans-serif and rounded stencil.
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses rounded terminals and stencil gaps
Central numeral is a clean, sharp-edged geometric sans-serif
Top text features a hard-edged, offset drop shadow to the bottom-right
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numeral 4 has an open top or specific geometric proportions
Stencil gaps are placed at the mid-points of vertical strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A small, vibrant, decorative stencil header paired with a massive, sober geometric focal point.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric clarity for the central numeral
Rounded stencil aesthetic for the header

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a light gray textured background with thin black crosshairs and two concentric white circles centered on the canvas. Add a subtle vertical line extending from the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a massive dark charcoal geometric numeral in the center. Add a line of widely spaced red stencil text at the top with a hard black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the central numeral the largest element?
Are the background lines thin and technical?
Is the top text red with a black shadow?
Is the overall palette restricted to gray, black, white, and red?

mustAchieve: High contrast between numeral and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for centered alignment of all elements
Ensure the stencil gaps are visible
Verify the technical lines intersect at the center
Confirm the red text has a distinct offset shadow
recipe.reuseFormula: Technical Film Leader Grid + Massive Geometric Numeral + Stencil Header
